description: GOAL-BASED TRADING RULES — replaces all previous stop/target logic. Every trade is sized and managed to achieve $3,000/month with minimal losses.

monthly_goal.stop_trading_if: Daily loss reaches -$75. Walk away. Tomorrow is a new day.

core_principle: Small targets, tiny stops, many trades. Take profit GREEDILY. Never let a winner become a loser. $3,000/month = 60 trades at +$50 or 30 trades at +$100. NOT 1 trade at +$3,000.

position_sizing_by_goal.description: Size every trade so that max loss is EXACTLY $25. Calculate units precisely.
position_sizing_by_goal.formula: Units = FLOOR($25 ÷ stop_distance_per_unit). Always round DOWN. Never round up.

pre_submit_checklist.1_verify_risk: Units × stop_distance MUST be ≤ $25. If not, reduce units.
pre_submit_checklist.2_verify_rr: R:R MUST be ≥ 1:2 BEFORE submitting. If not, don't place the trade.
pre_submit_checklist.3_verify_tp_sl: Both TP and SL must be set. Verify after submission.
pre_submit_checklist.4_verify_sl_saved: After modifying any SL, re-read the position to CONFIRM it actually changed. TradingView sometimes doesn't save.

gap_and_go.stop: Low of first 1-minute candle — usually $0.10-$0.50 from entry
gap_and_go.target: First spike — take profit within 5-15 minutes

penny_stock_momentum.stop: Low of first 1-minute candle — very tight $0.10-$0.30
penny_stock_momentum.target: First spike or +2x risk amount — sell into strength

swing_trade_forex.stop: 15-20 pips max — tighter than ATR for goal-based sizing

swing_trade_stocks.stop: $2-$5 from entry — tight, based on recent candle low/high

overnight_swing.stop: Wider but TINY position — max loss still $25

profit_taking_rules.description: BE GREEDY WITH PROFITS. Take them fast. Never let a winner become a loser.
profit_taking_rules.rule_1: As soon as profit reaches +$25 → move SL to breakeven. ZERO exceptions.
profit_taking_rules.rule_2: At +$50 → take HALF the position. Lock +$25 minimum.
profit_taking_rules.rule_3: At +$75 → move SL to lock +$50 on remaining half.
profit_taking_rules.rule_4: At +$100 → close entire position. Take the money. Move to next trade.
profit_taking_rules.rule_5: NEVER hold a trade hoping for more after +$100. Close and find next setup.
profit_taking_rules.rule_6: If trade hasn't reached +$25 within 2 hours → close at whatever P&L. Capital is better used elsewhere.
profit_taking_rules.golden_rule: A $50 profit taken is ALWAYS better than a $1,494 profit given back. ALWAYS.
profit_taking_rules.time_limit: CLOSE ALL TRADES BY END OF SESSION. No overnight holds. Maximum trade duration = 1 day.

session_close_times.forex_commodities: Close by 22:00 Oslo (NY close) — no holding forex/gold/oil overnight
session_close_times.us_stocks: Close by 22:00 Oslo (US market close) — no holding stocks overnight
session_close_times.eu_adr_stocks: Close by 22:00 Oslo — same as US stocks
session_close_times.crypto: Close by 00:00 Oslo — crypto has no close but we stop at midnight
session_close_times.penny_stocks: Close within 30 minutes of entry — NEVER hold penny stocks

profit_taking_rules.exception: NONE. Close everything daily. If trade hasn't hit target by session close → close at market. A small loss or small gain is better than overnight gap risk.
profit_taking_rules.lesson: WTI stopped out overnight at 3am (-$2.86). Gold gapped down after we couldn't monitor. Overnight = uncontrolled risk.

pre_market_standing_orders.description: When a high-scoring trade is identified the night before (earnings, FDA, major catalyst), place a limit order BEFORE going to sleep. Don't wait for morning scan — morning is too late for gap plays.
pre_market_standing_orders.rule: If penny stock or gap-and-go candidate scores 7+ with confirmed catalyst for next day → place limit order that night at a reasonable gap entry level.
pre_market_standing_orders.example: ARAI scored 8/9 at 02:00 Oslo with earnings next morning. Should have placed limit at $1.20 that night. ARAI gapped to $1.65 (+85%). We would have filled at $1.20 and made +$112 on 250 shares.
pre_market_standing_orders.lesson: ARAI April 15: identified at 02:00, scored 8/9, said 'wait for morning.' By morning it was +85%. Never wait — place the order the night before.

daily_routine.morning: Check journal — how much of daily $150 target achieved. How many trades left.
daily_routine.each_trade: Before placing: will this make me +$50-$100? Is the max loss $25? If not → don't trade.
daily_routine.end_of_day: Log total daily P&L. If +$150 reached → stop trading. If -$75 reached → stop trading.
daily_routine.weekly_review: Am I on track for $3,000/month? Adjust number of trades, not trade size.

what_changed_from_before.old_approach: Big position, wide stop, hope for home run
what_changed_from_before.new_approach: Small position, tight stop, many quick wins
